O owner decision 2026-09-26 (main); S parts lists
S data book; POH placard, GSG 02527
S TRA rim 10 / 6 in, flange .81 / .75 in
D outer rib to the shoulder
E hidden (main); M PCD, E count (nose)
O owner decision · S sourced · M photo-measured · E estimated · D derived · G gear.py. s < 0 = main inboard (brake) side.
adjacent parts, free tyre, TRA env.
Drawn from the parameter tables of model/wheels.py (PTable: value + source tag + note): tyre envelopes MAIN_TYRE_ENV / NOSE_TYRE_ENV, sections, rims, fairing, brake, axles; never from the mesh. Axle
positions and the gear context (trailing arm, leg, shock, nose fork) from model/gear.py, drawn as adjacent parts (phantom). Photos and their measurement working stay in the git-ignored refs/cache.

First-angle projection. Each assembly: SIDE view from port (principal), FRONT view from ahead to its right (upper half in section through the axle), TOP view from above below it; for the main wheel also view C from
starboard (inboard / brake face) at the far right. Each group's side / front views stand on one ground line.

OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 - main tyre 8.50-10 Type III (tyre makers, parts lists, four photo methods; TRA OD 627-652, drawn free OD 640). Jane's / Pilatus drawing 22x8.50-10 (OD 559, not a listed tyre size)
superseded, shown in the accent colour. Axles and static stance kept: axle WL 279 = the loaded radius, the tyre flat on the ground over a 250 mm patch (41 mm deflection) with a 6 mm sidewall bulge.

3-D model: gear.MAIN_TYRE still R 279.5 (22 in). The Stage-3 wheel step takes the tyre from wheels.py and re-derives the LD-1 leg-door scallop (R 292 -> about R 333) and the round well (bays), the retracted
protrusion (POH ~1 in) and every fit_check row; sheet L4 then gets its tyre circles and the 8.50-10 call-out.

Tyre section: tangent arcs - crown R to the tread half-width, shoulder round, upper sidewall (radius solved: tangent to the shoulder, max width W/2 at 0.50 H), lower sidewall to where the tyre leaves the rim-flange tip
round. At the TRA max shoulder width the modelled section is Ø578.6, inside the TRA max Ø578.9.

Main hub fairing (POH: fairings on the outer hubs), painted in the leg-door colour; its face stands 9 mm outboard of the tyre's max width, so retracted it is the lowest point of the stowed wheel (the Stage-3 protrusion

Main brake: six pistons, three retractors, steel friction surfaces, bolted to the axle (POH 7-4-10); 3 rotors / 2 stators inferred from the overhaul kit (24 pads, 2 stators, 48 rivets). Housing, stack and torque tube sized
inside the inboard wheel half [E]; one piston lobe is shown in section.

No markings (owner decision): no sidewall lettering, brand names or placards on wheels or tyres. The tread grooves become geometry in Stage 3 (replacing render/lookdev.py render_grooves). Screw, valve and tie-bolt
clocking is the drawn pose (the wheels turn); starboard units are mirror images. The main leg door (LD-1) is not shown.
